name: 650nm Red Laser Diode Module
description: Like a sci-fi targeting beam! Concentrated 650nm red optical laser diode for security tripwires.
realWorldAnalogy: Like a sci-fi targeting beam! Concentrated 650nm red optical laser diode for security tripwires.

hazards: Direct eye exposure to laser beam can cause retinal injury
safety.childSafeAlternative: Never look directly into laser aperture; use target reflective paper only

wiringGuidance: Connect Signal (Green wire) to digital pin 8 and - (Dark Slate wire) to GND.
commonMistakes: Pointing the laser beam at eyes, faces, or reflective surfaces (serious eye safety hazard).
Leaving the laser diode powered continuously without heat dissipation.

miniExperiment.title: Laser Pulse Blaster
miniExperiment.expectedOutput: A bright red 650nm laser beam pulses on and off every half second onto a safe target sheet.
